description: Reified 'Statement' collection (WP2.3): a group of related fields modelled as its own Subject.

Statement.description: This field is used to record the actual textual content of the statement describing the documented person.

Statement Type.description: This field is used to record the formal type of the statement made about the documented person.

Statement Language.description: This field is used to record the language of the statement describing the documented person.

Statement Source Reference.description: This field is used to link to a source text from which the statement describing the documented physical thing is derived.
